title: fix(plugin-auth): the AI service account register door answers a licence refusal with its own status and code, not 500 (ADR-0151 D7)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBKUZpgQzQrwh5rhEvnP4QoR)_

Fixes #32127

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：注册 AI 服务账号的接口（`POST /api/v1/auth/service-account/register`）在许可证插件拒绝写入时，按插件声明的状态码作答（如 402），不再一律 500；两次写入（`sys_user` 与 `sys_member`）都覆盖，被拒时什么都不落库。
- 为什么改：ADR-0151 D7 让许可证插件在身份写入上拒绝注册；cloud 的 AI 席位上限（cloud#3886）超额时，管理员现在看到的是"服务器故障"，而不是"AI 席位已满"。
- 风险与回滚：只改注册这一扇门；没有声明形状（数字状态码 400-599 + 字符串 code）的错误仍答 500，校验失败与授权存储 503 不变。回滚即还原本 PR 一个提交。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/service-account-doors.ts` 的 `declaredWriteRefusal` 与 `vendorRefusal` 开头的分支；再看两份测试。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/service-account-doors.test.ts src/service-account-register-licence-refusal.test.ts`，预期 30 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`runRegisterServiceAccount` (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/service-account-doors.ts`) now answers a refusal that a hook or engine middleware **declares** on either of its two writes:

- **The `sys_user` insert.** The unit of work's catch reads `validationRefusal(error) ?? declaredWriteRefusal(error)`; before, everything that was not `VALIDATION_FAILED` reached the `serviceAccountRoute` wrapper and answered `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`.
- **The `sys_member` insert through better-auth `addMember`.** `vendorRefusal` asks `declaredWriteRefusal` first when the throw carries no vendor `body.code`; before, it kept the status but answered `code: INTERNAL_ERROR`.

A declaration is a numeric `status`/`statusCode` in 400-599 **and** a non-empty string `code` on the throw. Either half missing, or a status outside the band, is a fault and keeps its old answer (500 at the wrapper). An `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` is excluded, so the route's own 503 in the shared seam's words is unchanged. The wrapper in `auth-plugin.ts` is not edited: the door returns its answer and the wrapper renders it as before.

### The declared-error reader reused (the order asked for it named)

`declaredWriteRefusal` composes `@objectstack/types`' shared reader rather than a second predicate:

- `resolveThrownHttpError`: the declared status (both spellings) and the closed `code`;
- `demotedDeclaredCode`: the producer's own spelling when it is not a vocabulary member;
- `declaredRefusalMessage`: whether a 5xx message was addressed to the caller.

This is the same reader `/api/v1/data` (`thrownCodeFields` in `data-error-classification.ts`) and `admin-user-endpoints.ts`' `grantRefusal` already use, so register answers this throw the way those doors do. `plugin-hono-server`'s `declaredEnvelopeForThrow` was not reused: it accepts only a status in `HttpStatusErrorCodeMap` and a registered code, and a 402 with `ai_seat_limit_reached` passes neither.

### The wire answer

| Throw | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `{ statusCode: 402, code: 'ai_seat_limit_reached' }` on `sys_user` | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` | `402 { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', declaredCode: 'ai_seat_limit_reached', message }` |
| same, on `sys_member` via `addMember` | `402 INTERNAL_ERROR` | `402 { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', declaredCode: 'ai_seat_limit_reached', message: 'The AI service account could not be added to the organization, so it was not registered: …' }` |
| `{ statusCode: 403, code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED' }` (a registered code) | `500` | `403 { code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED', message }`, no `declaredCode` |
| `{ statusCode: 503, code: 'ai_seat_cap_unknown' }` | `500` | `503 { code: 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', declaredCode: 'ai_seat_cap_unknown', message: 'The request could not be completed.' }`; the producer's message travels only with `refusal: true` |
| no code, no status, status 700, empty code, plain `Error` | `500` | `500` (unchanged) |

**For cloud: read `declaredCode ?? code`.**

### Deviation from the card's wording (governing text wins)

The card asks for "that status and that code" in `error.code`. **Governing text: ADR-0112 D4** (rulings on #9106 and #9232): `error.code` is a closed vocabulary at every door, and a producer's unregistered spelling rides `error.declaredCode`. `ai_seat_limit_reached` is in neither `StandardErrorCode` nor `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER`, and the ledger registers framework packages only (#4805 ruling), so the code travels in `declaredCode`, with `code` the status-derived member (`VALIDATION_ERROR` for 402). Seat 2 agreed this reading before implementation.

### Measured: how better-auth surfaces an adapter-thrown error

The card's addendum left this unverified. On better-auth 1.7.12, with the objectql adapter over the package's in-memory engine double and the engine's `sys_member` insert throwing the cap error, `auth.api.addMember` rejects with **the same `Error` instance**: `statusCode: 402`, `code: 'ai_seat_limit_reached'`, no `body`, keys `["statusCode","code"]`. That is why `vendorRefusal` answered `402 INTERNAL_ERROR`, and it is the shape the new branch reads. The wire suite below drives this through the real vendor.

## Tests

- `service-account-doors.test.ts` (real ObjectQL over better-sqlite3, real `sys_user` row rules; a new top-level `describe`, six cases):
  - a `beforeInsert` hook throwing the 402 on the agent row: exact body, no agent row, no new membership;
  - an engine middleware throwing the 402 on the `sys_member` insert: 402 + `declaredCode`, and the user row is rolled back by the real `transaction()`;
  - a registered code travels in `code` with no `declaredCode`;
  - a declared 503: status and code kept, message withheld; with `refusal: true` the message travels;
  - five undeclared shapes still reject (the wrapper's 500);
  - an `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` inside the write still rejects as the outage.
- `service-account-register-licence-refusal.test.ts` (new file; no existing harness mounts the service-account routes): the plugin's real route on Hono, a real `AuthManager` session (an organization administrator, organization active), the real vendor `addMember`. Control 201; `POST /api/v1/auth/service-account/register` answers 402 with `ai_seat_limit_reached` and no `sys_user`/`sys_member` row when the `sys_user` insert is refused; 402 with `ai_seat_limit_reached` when the `sys_member` insert is refused through better-auth. The double runs no transaction, so that stage's rollback is the door suite's pin.

### Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, landed on disk and restored to HEAD; both suites, 30 tests)

| # | Mutation | Red |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | `validationRefusal(error) ?? declaredWriteRefusal(error)` → `validationRefusal(error)` | 4 failed: the three user-row cases, and the wire answers `expected 500 to be 402` |
| A2 | the `vendorRefusal` branch disabled | 2 failed: both membership cases, `"code": "INTERNAL_ERROR"` (the card addendum's defect) |
| A3 | 5xx message always forwarded | 1 failed: the declared-503 case |
| A4 | the `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` exclusion removed | 1 failed: the outage case |
| A5 | the string-`code` requirement removed | 1 failed: the undeclared-shapes case |

A1's first attempt was refused by the tool before running (the replacement was a substring of the anchor); it was re-run with a distinct replacement.

## Acceptance notes

- A security item found beside this change is with the owner seat.
- The lifecycle doors (suspend, resume, set-owner, retire, revoke/restore key) share the wrapper and are not changed.

## Verification

Head `d90b9fc5` (the branch's three commits plus one merge of `origin/main` at `0f7389cc`; the incoming commits touch none of `plugin-auth`, `types`, `core`, `objectql`, `spec`).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (src, examples, test layer) and the whole package suite, under `os-verify-lock`, at `49287a70`: exit 0, **Test Files 256 passed (256), Tests 4596 passed, 10 skipped**. The one later commit adds comment lines to the two test files only; both suites re-ran after it: **30 passed (30)**.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the three touched source files: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 66 families; all run: **65 exit 0**, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3: needs a full repo build; CI's Lint and Repo Gates runs it). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 66 accounted, 0 unrun.
- `check:error-code-casing` went red on the first sweep (the test fixtures spell the downstream code `ai_seat_limit_reached` at a `code:` position); each such line now carries an `adr0112-ok:` reason (a downstream licence plugin's own spelling, which the door demotes to `declaredCode`), and the gate re-ran exit 0.
- Measurement script for the better-auth reading was a throwaway test file, deleted before the first commit.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
